# SOC-2 — local readiness workspace

> Open-source GitHub configuration assessment and evidence review with Python,
> OPA/Rego, and a local browser workspace. A separate public demo uses synthetic
> data. Results describe scoped checks, not SOC 2 certification or an audit opinion.

This is an optional reading index, not an agent permission or tool-discovery
protocol. Read the current source and applicable instructions before acting.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/README.md): purpose, workflow comparison, setup, and scope.
- [Local GitHub assessment](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/docs/local-github-assessment.md): credentials, permissions, private outputs, and report/review startup.
- [Current architecture](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): implementation and data boundaries.
- [Documentation map](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/docs/README.md): current guides and explicitly historical designs.
- [Public project overview](https://safetymp.github.io/SOC-2/about.html): crawlable introduction.
- [Synthetic workspace demo](https://safetymp.github.io/SOC-2/): Cedarline customer review, release and quarter workpapers, pilot scopes and evidence trace.

## Implementation entry points

- [Real assessment CLI](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/scripts/assess_github.py): exactly three GitHub checks; remaining 34 controls outside scope.
- [GitHub collector](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/sensors/github_assessment.py): authenticated read-only observations with conservative missing-data handling.
- [Local viewer](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/scripts/serve_workspace.py): loopback-only report and exported-review startup.
- [Browser report model](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/demo/model.mjs): validation, scope separation, scores, and planning notes.
- [Fixture exporter](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/scripts/export_workspace.py): synthetic 20-control slice (11 technical, 9 procedural), 17 unevaluated.
- [Catalog and policies](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/catalog/README.md): mappings and wired control definitions.

## Interpretation limits

Real credentials stay with the local GitHub CLI, which sends authenticated reads
to GitHub. Reports and sanitized evidence stay in private local files outside Git
checkouts. The browser receives no token and has no upload/provider endpoint.
Real notes remain in tab memory until exported; exported reviews can restore them
on startup. Notes cannot turn FAIL into PASS or create a waiver. Missing evidence
and controls outside scope never count as passing. Historical locker and design
materials do not establish production storage, signatures, or operating effectiveness.
